Expanding on [other DSPA2 appendices)](https://dspa2.predictive.space/),
this [DSPA2 appendix](https://www.socr.umich.edu/DSPA2/) covers a discussion of building a mathematical model the length/duration of daylight and demonstrating supporting data science analytics for predicting the exact length of daylight (sunset to sunrise) for a given day, longitude, latitude, and altitude. 

**Note**: [This Part 2 of the DSPA Appendix 13 (Mathematical Modeling and Data Science Analytics of the Duration of Daylight)](https://socr.umich.edu/DSPA2/DSPA2_notes/DSPA_Appendix_13_DaylightMathModeling_Part2.html) is intentionally separated from the [main Part 1 of the DSPA Appendix 13 (Mathematical Modeling and Data Science Analytics of the Duration of Daylight)](https://socr.umich.edu/DSPA2/DSPA2_notes/DSPA_Appendix_13_DaylightMathModeling.html). It includes large data and JavaScript code supporting the plotly app. It includes the interactive 3D temporal animation app that allows manual navigation across longitude, latitude, altitude and time (daily).


```{r latitudeModelOffline, eval=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(plotly)
library(tidyr)

# Assume location_data is the pre-existing data frame with columns: latitude, longitude, altitude
# Example structure of location_data:
# location_data <- data.frame(
#   latitude = c(-90, -80, -70, -60, -50),
#   longitude = c(-180, -180, -180, -180, -180),
#   altitude = c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
# )

location_data <- # download the low geospatial resolution lon-lat-alt data
  read.csv("https://umich.instructure.com/files/37840607/download?download_frd=1", 
            header = TRUE)

# Define the days of the year
days <- 1:365

# Function to calculate daylight duration, including altitude
daylight_duration <- function(latitude, day_of_year, altitude) {
  if (is.na(latitude) || is.na(day_of_year) || is.na(altitude)) {
    return(NA)  # Return NA if any input is missing
  }
  
  R <- 6371000  # Earth's radius in meters
  
  # Solar declination angle
  declination <- 23.44 * sin((2 * pi / 365) * (day_of_year - 81))
  
  # Altitude correction in radians, only for positive altitudes
  if (altitude > 0) {
    altitude_correction <- -sqrt(2 * altitude / R) * (180 / pi)
  } else {
    altitude_correction <- 0  # No correction for sea level or below
  }
  
  # Calculate hour angle argument, clamped within [-1, 1]
  hour_angle_arg <- -tan(latitude * pi / 180) * tan(declination * pi / 180) -
    sin(altitude_correction * pi / 180)
  hour_angle_arg <- pmax(pmin(hour_angle_arg, 1), -1)
  
  # Calculate hour angle
  hour_angle <- acos(hour_angle_arg)
  
  # Calculate daylight duration in hours
  daylight_hours <- (2 * hour_angle) / (pi / 12)  # Convert radians to hours
  
  # Handle cases of 24-hour daylight or darkness
  if (hour_angle_arg <= -1) { daylight_hours <- 24  # Continuous daylight
  } else if (hour_angle_arg >= 1) { daylight_hours <- 0   # Continuous night
  }
  
  return(daylight_hours)
}


# Calculate daylight duration for each (latitude, longitude, day) combination
daylight_data <- location_data %>%  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(daylight = list(sapply(days, function(day) 
    daylight_duration(latitude, day, altitude)))) %>%
  unnest_wider(daylight, names_sep = "_") %>% ungroup()

# Convert days of the year to actual dates
# Define the starting date (e.g., January 1, 2024)
start_date <- as.Date("2024-01-01")

# Convert days of the year to actual dates
daylight_data_long <- daylight_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("daylight_"), names_to = "day", 
               values_to = "daylight_hours") %>%
  mutate(day = as.numeric(gsub("daylight_", "", day)))  # Extract numeric day


# daylight_data_long <- daylight_data_long %>%
#   mutate(date = start_date + (day - 1))  # Convert day number to actual date

# Create a combined label for "Day X - Date"
daylight_data_long <- daylight_data_long %>%
  mutate(day_label = paste("Day", day, "-", format(date, "%B %d, %Y")))  # Combine day number and date

# Define the starting date (e.g., January 1, 2024)
start_date <- as.Date("2024-01-01")

# Convert days of the year to actual dates
daylight_data_long <- daylight_data_long %>%
  mutate(date = start_date + (day - 1))  # Convert day number to actual date

# Create a combined label for "Day X - Date"
daylight_data_long <- daylight_data_long %>%
  mutate(day_label = paste("Day", day, "-", format(date, "%B %d, %Y")))  # Combine day number and date
# Format the date as "Month Day, Year" for display in the tooltip
daylight_data_long <- daylight_data_long %>%
  mutate(date_text = format(date, "%B %d, %Y"))  # Format as "Month Day, Year"

g2 <- list(projection = list(type = 'orthographic'),
           showland = TRUE, landcolor = "lightgray", lakecolor = "lightblue")

# Plotly code with updated frame to display day and date in slider
fig <- plot_ly(data = daylight_data_long, type = 'scattergeo', mode = 'markers',
  lat=~latitude, lon=~longitude, frame=~day_label,  # Use combined day and date label for frame
  marker = list(size = 6, opacity = 0.95), color = ~daylight_hours, colors = "RdYlBu",
  customdata = ~altitude,  # Altitude data for tooltip
  hovertemplate = paste('<i>Latitude</i>: %{lat:.2f}', '<br><i>Longitude</i>: %{lon:.2f}',
                        '<br><i>Altitude (m)</i>: %{customdata:.2f}',  
                        '<br><i>Date</i>: %{text}',  # Display formatted date
                        '<br><i>Daylight Hours</i>: %{marker.color:.2f}',
                        '<extra></extra>'),
  text = ~date_text,  # Assign date_text to the `text` property for hovertemplate
  showlegend = FALSE) %>%
  layout(geo = g2,
    title = list(text = "Daylight Length Over Earth Throughout the Year"),  # Set title in list format
    coloraxis = list(colorbar = list(title = "Daylight Hours"))  # Adjust coloraxis for colorbar
  )

fig  # Show the plot
```
